name: Introduction to Electrodynamics
description: Electrostatics: electric field, scalar potential, fundamental theorem of gradients, divergence/curl and divergence/curl theorem. Introduction to Dirac delta function. Energy stored in an electrostatic configuration. Capacitors, conductors. Dielectrics, polarization. Electric susceptibility. Magnetostatics. Biot-Savarts law, vector potential. Magnetic materials, magnetization. Energy stored in a magnetic field. Induced EMF due to changing magnetic field. Development of the differential form of the Maxwell's equations and Poynting vector. Reflection and refraction of EM waves.
